caption:
Every lead does not deserve the same response time.

Most owners run one speed for every inbound: one phone, one inbox, one clock. That treats a live phone call the same as a form filled out three days ago.

Build three tiers instead:

1. Hot: calls and quote requests. Respond in under 5 minutes.
2. Warm: form fills and quiz completions. Text back in 15 minutes, call within the hour.
3. Cold: past customers and dormant leads. Batch into a weekly send, no scramble.

Most service businesses need hours to answer a new lead. Few ever build a true Tier 1.

Want your pipeline built on this exact structure?
